title: The Innovator's Dilemma
author: Clayton M. Christensen
description: Explores how outstanding, well-managed companies can do everything right and yet still lose market leadership to disruptive innovations.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman explains the two systems that drive how we think: System 1 (fast, emotional, intuitive) and System 2 (slow, logical, deliberate).

title: Outliers: The Story of Success
author: Malcolm Gladwell
description: Examines the complex web of culture, family, generation, and idiosyncratic experiences behind high achievers and world-changing success.
